mathematics.assertion_tested: Rank-two full-support cycle cores, their common edges and pair-collapse multiplicities; comparison of core embeddings with direct cycle enumeration; the signed coefficient of N^(-1) in the circular-phase trace variance
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers, rational numbers and F_3,F_5,F_7,F_11,F_13
mathematics.conventions: sigma is the standard directed m-cycle; K=P_sigma-P_sigma^T-P_tau+P_tau^T; d(K) counts pairs whose identification annihilates K

bounds.cores: All directed q-cycles tau, 3<=q<=8, all five fields, retain full-support rank-two K
bounds.direct_embedding_controls: All m-cycles for 3<=m<=8 in all five fields, plus m=9 in fields 3,13 and m=10 in field 3
bounds.embedding_prediction: m=3..100 from the finite core table
bounds.field_coverage_argument: A 4x4 Pfaffian has absolute integer value <=12, so rank-two classification at p>=13 has no new modular zeros

non_claims: No full BGS or two-channel solution
Finite verification is not an all-order cancellation proof
No assumption that the first correction vanishes; the result records the actual table
